properties.name: Windsor Station approach

properties.name: Quebec Palais approach
properties.note: Brendan, 23 Oct 2026: from the end of the CN track north of Gare Palais straight to the station point

properties.name: Quebec junction tie
properties.note: Claude, 23 Oct 2026: the two CN lines out of Quebec meet here mid-piece (neither ends there), so the collection does not join them; a 40 m tie across the junction

properties.name: Lanoraie junction tie
properties.note: Claude, 24 Oct 2026: the Joliette branch (St. Lawrence and Industry Village, "Current") ends 480 m north of the CP main line at Lanoraie and joins it only by the abandoned line to the old village; a straight tie from the branch end to the main line at the station, to be confirmed by Brendan

properties.name: Park Avenue wye, west leg
properties.note: Brendan, 24 Oct 2026: the Windsor Station - Quebec trains take the other side of the wye near Park Avenue (no reversal at Mile End). The leg is the collection's "Outremont yard" piece from the Montreal West line to the Park Avenue line, here as main-line track

properties.name: Montreal West wye, east leg
properties.note: Brendan, 24 Oct 2026: the leg of the wye at Montreal West by which trains run between Windsor Station and Park Avenue. The collection has the curve only inside a long "Current" siding piece (Windsor - Outremont); this is that curve, from the main line east of Montreal West to the line north

properties.name: Port Alfred tie
properties.note: Claude, 25 Oct 2026: the Port Alfred yard track meets the Roberval & Saguenay main line mid-piece (neither ends there), so the collection does not join them; a short tie

properties.name: Mont Joli tie (C&GT - CN)
properties.note: Claude, 25 Oct 2026: the Canada & Gulf Terminal meets the CN main line east of Mont Joli mid-piece; a 25 m tie so its trains reach the CN station

properties.name: Dorval CP - CN connection
properties.note: Claude, 25 Oct 2026: Pool 15 / 6 (CP Table 49) leave the CP for the CN at Dorval (Note A); the collection's CP and CN main lines pass 11 m apart east of Dorval without a join; a tie there

properties.name: Coteau main-line tie (Quebec / Ontario collections)
properties.note: Claude, 25 Oct 2026: the CN Montreal - Toronto main line changes from the Quebec collection to the Ontario one near Coteau; the two pieces end 5 m apart and were not joined

properties.name: Toronto Union Station, CP approach from the east
properties.note: Brendan, 25 Oct 2026: CP trains reach Union Station from the east by the CP connector east of the station (the collection's "Leaside to Union" line, which stops 200 m short of the station point)

properties.name: Ottawa east gap (CN Montreal - Ottawa)
properties.note: Brendan, 25 Oct 2026: a gap east of Ottawa that diverted the CN Montreal - Ottawa trains off their proper path into Ottawa Union Station

properties.name: NYC Cornwall - Helena, N.Y. (over the border)
properties.note: Brendan, 25 Oct 2026: the NYC Ottawa line from the end of the Ontario collection's main line over the border to the terminus at Helena, N.Y.

properties.name: Richford, Vt. (CP, Newport and Richford Ry.)
properties.note: Brendan, 26 Oct 2026: the CP line through Richford, Vt. from the border south of Abercorn to the border before Glenton, Que. (missing from the collections)

properties.name: International Railway Bridge, Fort Erie - border (Claude, APPROXIMATE)
properties.note: Claude, 27 Oct 2026: from the end of the Canada Southern eastbound main at the bridge approach out to mid-river (the international boundary), for the TH&B / NYC Buffalo trains of Table 56. To confirm.

properties.name: TH&B - Michigan Central junction, Welland (Claude)
properties.note: Claude, 27 Oct 2026: ties the end of the TH&B main line at Welland to the Canada Southern eastbound main (the collection pieces are 4 m apart but the graph tied the TH&B to the westbound main only).

properties.name: CP - NYC connection, St. Thomas (Claude)
properties.note: Brendan, 29 Oct 2026: the CP tracks connect directly to the NYC tracks at St. Thomas and the CP trains run through to the NYC station. The collection's NYC siding from the end of the CP (Credit Valley) line to the station (sidings of other railways are left out of the CP graph), tied to the main at the station.

properties.name: TH&B (BW&LE) Waterford wye, east leg tie (Claude)
properties.note: Brendan, 29 Oct 2026: TH&B trains run through the wye between the two Brantford Waterloo & Lake Erie pieces onto the NYC to the NYC Waterford station. The east leg starts mid-segment on the BW&LE main (no shared vertex): tie along the main's line. Plus a 15 m tie from the east leg end to the NYC eastbound main (the leg met only the westbound main, which the station does not sit on).

properties.name: TH&B - NYC eastbound main tie, Waterford (Claude)
properties.note: see the BW&LE Waterford wye tie

properties.name: Quebec - Levis ferry crossing (Claude)
properties.note: Levis station to Brendan's Quebec wharf point (24 Oct 2026); straight across the river

properties.name: NTR gap west of St. Isidore (Claude)
properties.note: 29 Oct 2026: the Quebec collection's two NTR main-line pieces end 1.2 km apart near St. Isidore (Table 23 trains had run straight)

properties.name: Nicolet branch tie at St. Leonard (Claude)
properties.note: 29 Oct 2026: the Nicolet branch (filed as abandoned sidings) to the Drummondville line at St. Leonard

properties.name: Nicolet branch, St. Leonard - Nicolet (collection piece)
properties.note: 29 Oct 2026: the collection's piece (its note: Nicolet - wharf abandoned 1926, the rest 1955) is dropped by the pre-1948 abandonment filter; in service in 1948 (CN Table 1)

properties.name: St. Lawrence & Atlantic main line, Richmond - Norton (border)
properties.note: Claude, 30 Oct 2026 (CN Table 59): the collection's main-line piece with its doubled-back stretch south of Compton removed (the trace runs north about 1.4 km, jumps back and runs it again: 1.9 mi too long). Otherwise as in the collection.

properties.name: Ste. Rosalie: St. Lawrence & Atlantic beside the Drummondville line
properties.note: Claude, 30 Oct 2026 (CN Table 59): the two lines run side by side 24 m apart from the junction to beyond Ste. Rosalie station; this piece of the St. L. & A. ties them at the station, so trains on either line stop at the one Ste. Rosalie point.

properties.name: Grand Trunk main line in 1948 (collection piece 728): by Lachine, not the 1961 Turcot West - Dorval line
properties.note: Brendan, 30 Oct 2026: until 1961 the main line ran from Turcot West through Lachine station (the old Lachine line) to Dorval; the line between Turcot West and Dorval was built in 1961 as a bypass. This copy of the collection piece follows the old line (the collection's Lachine spur and Montreal & Lachine pieces) between those junctions.
